definitions.full: H4024. Migdol מִגְדּוֺל noun masculine tower , 2Sam 22:51 Qr (Kt מגדיל = Psalm 18:51 מַגְדִּל ). מִגְדֹּל proper name ( מִגְדּוֺל only Jer 46:14 ) fortified city on the northeast border of Egypt Exod 14:2 ; Num 33:7 ; Jer 44:1 ; 46:14 ; Ezek 29:10 ; 30:6 ; Coptic meschtôl (Champoll. occurrences.englishText: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.
They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
He gives great deliverance to his king,
The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
therefore, behold, I am against you, and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.
